title: AdminListWalkthroughBookingsCallableResponse
description: The saved calendar (null when none is saved), the calendar slots come from now and whether it is the built-in default, how many slots are open from now, and the bookings in the range, earliest slot first.

toDate.description: Last India-time day of the range, included.

calendar.description: The calendar the website's slots come from now. source is saved when staff saved one (availability), else default: the built-in Monday to Friday 10:00 to 18:00 IST calendar, 30-minute slots, 2 hours' lead, 14 days ahead. Saving a calendar (expectedRevision 0) replaces the default.

openSlotCount.description: Slots the website offers now, across the calendar's horizon.

truncated.description: True when more than 500 bookings fall in the range.
